outcome: Preference for Cesarean section in a hypothetical healthy pregnancy
cohort: 3616 childless young women between 18 and 40 years of age who planned to have at least one child in the future, from 8 OECD countries
finding: One in ten young women preferred Cesarean section, with rates varying by country, and fear of labor pain and physical damage being primary reasons.
mod_finding: Preference for Cesarean section was related to fear of childbirth.
country: Australia, Canada, Chile, England, Germany, Iceland, New Zealand, United States
